---
title: "Reset a manager's Admin access"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-10 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Let another manager back into Admin when they have lost or replaced the
phone that holds their passkey, or forgotten their PIN.

## Applies to

Managers only, for another manager. You cannot reset your own Admin access:
change your own passkeys and PIN with [MGR-08 Manage your passkeys and
PIN](passkeys-and-pin.qmd).

## Before you begin

- Admin is open for you. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).
- The manager whose access you are resetting is in the shop, ready to set up
  a new passkey or PIN straight after the reset.

## What a reset does

A reset only takes away. It removes every passkey and the PIN that the other
manager uses to open Admin, and locks Admin if they have it open. It does not
give you, or anyone else, a way into Admin as them.

The next time they open Admin, they set up a new passkey or PIN themselves,
exactly as on their first day. Until they do, anyone who clicks their name
could set it up instead. That is why they must be in the shop, ready, when
you reset.

## Procedure

1. On the Admin overview, under **The shop**, click the **Staff working here**
   card. The **Staff** list opens.
2. Click **Reset Admin access** beside the manager's name. A question opens
   under their name: **Reset** followed by their name and **Admin access?**

   ![Resetting a manager's Admin access](/screenshots/manager/staff-reset.png)

3. Read the question.
4. Click **Yes, reset Admin access**. Under their name, the list shows **Admin
   not set up yet**.
5. Click **Lock Admin** in the green bar at the top of Admin. The screen shows
   **🔒 Admin is locked**.
6. Click **Switch** at the top right of the screen. The Welcome screen opens.

### The other manager sets up Admin again

The manager whose access you reset carries out these steps themselves, on
the same tablet or computer.

7. Click your name on the Welcome screen.
8. Click **Admin** at the top of the screen. The screen shows **Set up how you
   open Admin**, followed by your name.
9. Click **Set up a passkey** and follow the prompt on your new phone or
   device. Or click **Set a PIN**, type a PIN of 4 to 8 digits, click
   **Again**, type the same PIN, and click **Set PIN**.

   Admin opens for you.

## Result

The **Staff** list shows **Admin set up** under the other manager's name.
Their old phone no longer opens Admin. The reset is recorded in the shop's
audit log, with your name.

## If something goes wrong

### You can't reset your own Admin access

You clicked **Reset Admin access** for yourself. Change your own passkeys and
PIN with **Passkeys and PIN** in the green bar. See [MGR-08 Manage your
passkeys and PIN](passkeys-and-pin.qmd).

### Only a manager has Admin access to reset

The staff member is a groomer. A groomer does not open Admin, so there is
nothing to reset.

### Only that manager, with Admin open, can change how they open Admin

Someone tried to set up the other manager's passkey or PIN while your Admin
was still open. Only that manager sets up their own, from a locked Admin.
Click **Lock Admin**, click **Switch**, and let them carry out steps 7 to 9.

### Admin is already set up and nobody expected it

If the other manager finds that Admin asks them to **Prove it's you** instead
of **Set up how you open Admin**, someone else set it up first. Reset their
Admin access again straight away, and tell the person responsible for the
shop's database, who can read the audit log.
